title: cursor-state-bridge trace event
description: JSONL event written to .omcs/cursor-state-bridge/trace.jsonl on every JSON-RPC call.

tool.description: MCP tool name, or method name for non-tools/call requests.

phase.description: Workflow-state phase touched by the call, when applicable; otherwise the JSON-RPC method category.

result.description: 'ok' on success or 'error' on JSON-RPC error response.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the handler in milliseconds.

task_id.description: Task identifier when the call carried one.

error_class.description: JSON-RPC error code label when 'result' is 'error'.

args_digest.description: Optional short digest of the call arguments.
